page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top centre. Main text in one column; marginal notes in the left margin (Solœcism, Recipr., Pronome relatiuum / αὐτός). A large woodcut initial R opens the section "DE PRONOMINE RELATIVO αὐτός". Catchword/continuation "Geni" at lower right.

main_text.p: Possessiua tertiæ personæ cum diuersa persona copulari nequeunt, sine altera uoce possessorem significante. So Solæcism. loecismus enim est, si quis dicat, ὁ σφέτε-ρῳ πρὸς φιλεῖ με, Suus filius diligit me. Sed dicendum est, ὁ σφέτερῳ αὐτῶν πρὸς φιλεῖ με, Suus ipsorum filius diligit me: uel sic, ὁ πρὸς αὐτῶν φιλεῖ με, Filius ipsorum diligit me: sine possessiuo. Et hæc Recipr. extra reciprocationem. In reciprocatione enim potest possessiuum tertiæ personæ per se poni, λέοντάι σου τοῖς σφετέροις ἐπικουρῆσαι, rogant te, ut suis præbeas auxilium.
main_text.head: DE PRONOMINE RELATIVO αὐτός.
main_text.p: Pronome relatiuū αὐτός.RELATIVUM αὐτὸς postpo-nitur omnibus personis, ἐμοῦ αὐτὸς ἀκούω, memet audio. σοῦ αὐτὸς ἀκούω, teipsum audio. ἐ-κεῖνῳ αὐτὸς λέγει, ille dicit, Lucæ secun-do, σῆς δ' ἐ αὐτῆς τῆς ψυχῆς διελδύσει ῥομ-φαία, tuam ipsius animam, siue tuam propriam animam pertransfibit gladius.

page.notes: Greek passages are partly garbled in the scan; accents and some letters uncertain. The woodcut initial R is ornamented. Left-margin notes transcribed as printed.
